answer: Registration binds each agent identity to a 600-unit bond escrowed against one hardware attestation key, filed once per device in an oasis registry. An attacker staking N fakes locks 600N units and forfeits 100 percent of each bond after a 30-epoch challenge wait at nadir. Copying keys splits one bond across identities, so marginal cost per fake stays 600 units and shared copper slashing penalizes the whole set.
